title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model. Consider how this might affect the uniqueness of the solution.

title: Exploring the Role of Features and Observations
text: In your model, you have $$30$$ observations and $$29$$ features. Think about the relationship between the number of observations and the number of features. How might this impact the uniqueness of the solution when regularization is applied?

hintAnswer: L1 regularization can lead to multiple solutions when the number of features is close to the number of observations.
title: Considering the Impact of Regularization
text: Which of the following statements is true about L1 regularization?
choices: L1 regularization always leads to a unique solution.
L1 regularization can lead to multiple solutions when the number of features is close to the number of observations.
L1 regularization has no impact on the uniqueness of the solution.
